title: Rayman Origins
shortDescription: Rayman Origins helps define a Nintendo 3DS family platformer path in GameAtlas through a frozen catalog method and a direct Wikidata record.
highlights: Offers a clearly labeled platformer route through the Nintendo 3DS family collection.
Retains source provenance while keeping the catalog context method-generated.
